map.输入石材色差(ΔE)、压缩强度、弯曲度等参数，按GB/T 9966标准判定石材质: Input stone color difference (Delta E), compressive strength, flexural degree and other parameters; judge the stone quality grade per GB/T 9966.
map.本工具依据 GB/T 9966、GB/T 18601，对输入的色差 ΔE、压缩强: This tool, per GB/T 9966 and GB/T 18601, automatically judges the natural-stone quality grade (premium/first-class/qualified/unqualified) from input color difference Delta E, compressive strength, flexural strength, bulk density and water absorption, and switches the corresponding standard limits by stone type (granite/marble/limestone/sandstone). Logic: four strengths and physical-chemical metrics all pass and Delta E<=1.0 -> premium; all pass and Delta E<=2.0 -> first-class; at least 3 pass and Delta E<=4.0 -> qualified; else unqualified. Judgment and calculation run locally in the browser; data is not uploaded.

map.石材类型选「花岗石」，色差 ΔE=3.5、压缩强度 120 MPa、弯曲强度 8: Stone type "Granite", color difference Delta E=3.5, compressive 120 MPa, flexural 8.5 MPa, bulk density 2.65, water absorption 0.35%. Granite limits: compressive 100, flexural 8, density 2.56, absorption <=0.60, all four pass; but Delta E=3.5 is neither <=1.0 nor <=2.0, so check passed count: all four pass and Delta E<=4.0, thus judged qualified.
Stone type "Marble", color difference Delta E=1.5, compressive 60 MPa, flexural 7.5 MPa, bulk density 2.30, water absorption 40%. Marble limit density 2.40, measured 2.30 fails, only 3 pass, still meets "passed>=3 and Delta E<=4.0", judged qualified.
map.四个等级具体怎么判？: How are the four grades judged specifically?
map.四项强度与理化指标全合格且 ΔE≤1.0 判优等品；全合格且 ΔE≤2.0 判一: Four strengths and physical-chemical metrics all pass and Delta E<=1.0 -> premium; all pass and Delta E<=2.0 -> first-class; passed>=3 and Delta E<=4.0 -> qualified; else unqualified. Color difference Delta E strongly affects high grades; control Delta E first when appearance matters.
map.不同石材的限值为什么差别这么大？: Why do limits differ so much across stones?
map.因为岩性不同。花岗石要求最高（压缩 100 MPa、吸水 ≤0.60%），大理石: Because lithology differs. Granite is strictest (compressive 100 MPa, absorption <=0.60%), marble 50 MPa / <=0.50%, limestone 60 MPa / <=3.00%, sandstone 70 MPa / <=3.00%. After choosing stone type the tool auto-applies the matching limits.
map.天然石材检测依据GB/T 9966《天然饰面石材试验方法》系列标准: Natural stone testing follows the GB/T 9966 series (Test Methods for Natural Facing Stone)
map.花岗石压缩强度≥100MPa，大理石≥50MPa，弯曲强度分别≥8和7MPa: Granite compressive >=100 MPa, marble >=50 MPa; flexural >=8 and >=7 MPa respectively
map.色差ΔE≤1.0为优等品，≤2.0为一等品，≤4.0为合格品: Color difference Delta E<=1.0 premium, <=2.0 first-class, <=4.0 qualified
map.吸水率反映石材致密程度，花岗石≤0.60%，大理石≤0.50%: Water absorption reflects stone density; granite <=0.60%, marble <=0.50%
map.室外用石材还应检测抗冻融性和耐磨性: Outdoor stone should also test freeze-thaw and abrasion resistance
